build_fastbpe_encoder: build a fastBPE encoder using a BPE codes file to apply subword tokenization to text
encode_text_with_fastbpe: encode a string using the fastBPE encode method to apply subword tokenization
decode_fastbpe_tokens: decode a BPE-encoded string using the fastBPE decode method to remove continuation symbols
review_fastbpe_config: review the fastBPEConfig dataclass to understand the bpe_codes field and its default value
test_fastbpe_init: test the fastBPE class initialization to verify it loads codes and raises on missing fastBPE
